caption: The drawing features two renderings of the same object within a lightly outlined rectangular border on an off-white background. The lower left section depicts a three-dimensional, colored image of a pair of antique candle snuffers, composed of metal. The snuffers have two rectangular finger holes, slightly rounded at the edges, connected to a curved handle that joins a scissor-like mechanism. Attached to this is a small, closed, box-shaped receptacle positioned above the blades, and a flat, circular element near the hinge. The primary colors used are shades of grey and blue, with hints of rust and brown, and there are dark shadows cast to the left of the object. In the upper right portion of the rectangle is a line drawing of the same object, shown from a different, top-down angle, rendered in light pencil without any shading or color. The artist's name, Hester Duany, is written in capital letters in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Snuffer
